objective: Release-gated isolated staging-user Android integration of the Nov16 1300 Character story collectibles, 120 Kingdom item art, Android sharp zoom, licensed offline sound director, dark apple-green mentions and Connect text legibility; production remains unchanged.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: BUKLOD production Android run 43811877721 published exact main 63ccd4b58ff02ff3c1535a1e05d3097fa8323c61, runtime 1.3.2, update 01a1e2e2-cb65-7733-bcb6-3519230c9cf4 on November 16, 2026. Release workflow independently rechecks the live production update ID before/after staging.
chosenApproach: Use exact current-main tree plus 131 isolated additive files from PRs 875,879-883 with two verified non-overlapping JSX merges. Publish staging-user via independent immutable Android preview export only after focused tests and production manifest parity; no production main push, live DB migrations or unverified 1300-art upload.
selectionRationale: Separates staging QA from production, prevents simultaneous DEV merges overwriting each other, and ensures unverified artwork or task events cannot mint Character inventory or credits.
alternativeApproaches: Blind merge draft DEV PRs into production main: rejected because Android production OTA uses protected release markers.
Run experimental 1300-item migrations on active Supabase as staging substitute: rejected because user data/RLS integrity risk.
Embed low-resolution 1300 item crops directly in OTA: rejected because asset quality and media payload.
Isolated verified staging-user release with offline fallbacks and no backend writes: selected.
